statusPolicy.advancement: This revision records the initial acceptance state. New immutable run reports may establish later results. Before promoting a status here, deliberately revise the initial-state validator assertions and attach evidence under this exact standard; historical summaries cannot qualify.
statusPolicy.sourceChanges: A source-fixed finding is not a passed system or backend; physical-device verification remains separate.

scope.historicalEvidence: context-only; never inherits PASS under this standard
scope.deviceScope: qualify each device, GPU driver, display mode, engine and backend combination

policy.outputCadence: selected physical refresh divided by output content rate must be an integer; verify actual presents
policy.unsupportedCadence: use a supported matching mode or report the limitation; never invent an 80-Hz mode on a 60/120-Hz panel
policy.sourceIdentity: measure retired guest ticks and distinct content updates separately; present count is not guest FPS
policy.unsafeMidpoint: hold an authentic endpoint and count the fallback; do not count it as useful generation
policy.direct: raw emulator Surface; no intermediate frame-generation renderer
policy.aspect: preserve native display aspect; contain the complete image; maximize size without cropping
policy.lsfgPrivate: private permitted build and payload only; no publication or redistribution

backendRequirements.unsupportedBackend: record capability failure and visible fallback; an unsupported path is not a PASS

identity: immutable APK, engine, model/payload and input artifact SHA-256 digests
device model, GPU, driver, OS, actual display mode and backend that ran
title, save/checkpoint, settings, workload/input trace and run epoch
physicalPresentation: actual physical-present timestamps or fences matched to frame identities, with raw interval distribution
integer scan holds on the actual measured display clock; no unexplained early, late, dropped or repeated holds in accepted moving windows
startup, scene changes, steady motion and recovery separated; averages and requested timestamps alone do not qualify
guestClockAudio: retired guest ticks and emulated-time versus monotonic-time trace; declared and applied clocks and correction ratio
distinct content update cadence separate from emulation clock and presentation cadence
audio timestamps, queue underruns/overruns and A/V drift under the same run; correction remains within 0.75 percent of declared clock
generatedContent: lossless endpoint A, exact generated midpoint, endpoint B and actual presented-output captures from moving gameplay
each capture bound to pair IDs, generation fraction, model/backend, raw GPU output identity and physical-present event
held-out real intermediate frames from deterministic replay or a suitable high-rate source, never used as generator inputs
motion and occlusion ROI comparisons against held-frame and blend baselines, including HUD, scrolling, disocclusions and scene cuts
reviewed contact sheets and quantitative errors; neither different pixels nor a 0.5 blend coefficient alone proves useful interpolation
adaptation: GPU completion-fence latency and memory use, including tail latency while the emulator competes for GPU time
capability checks, deadline admission, thermal/load stress and sustained recovery hysteresis on representative weaker and stronger GPUs
overload reduces cost or disables generation while preserving guest speed; every fallback is counted and backend is visible
geometryAndOled: screenshots verify native aspect, complete image, correct panel orientation and screen assignment
panels wake only for bounded active tests; cleanup runs after success and failure and verifies both panels off
secondary direct display and touch remain correct when present; optional secondary generation cannot block primary qualification

sourceFindings.summary: Off bypasses the intermediate Surface; software and hardware hosts separately apply near-native clock synchronization.

Pre-change September 4 audit found load-driven guest downclocking. Current source removes that controller and its probes, and software, GLES and native-adapter session setters reject corrections outside 0.75 percent of the original declared clock. Runtime proof of preserved speed is still required.

The pre-change panel-ratio path was fixed at one; it has now been removed with the load-tier probes. Current source still uses nominal synchronized clocks and lacks a proved measured fractional-panel clock lock. Physical interval and long-run phase evidence remain required.
Hardware work capacity reports zero because CPU submission time does not measure asynchronous GPU completion.
All native adapters are labelled trusted 60-Hz producers, although aPS3e has no declared/paced clock or measured-FPS hook.
Eden's paced VI base still divides by game swap interval; its separately quantized Vulkan present stamps are not retired guest-frame identities.
The September 3 demonstration records a Cemu Vulkan surface-recreation SIGSEGV after LSFG attaches. It is a blocker, not successful integration evidence.
Wii overrides Dolphin to Vulkan; GameCube remains GLES. ARMSX2 and Azahar select Vulkan through their opt-in runtime.
Phase-one routes other than explicit opengl use the software host, including SwanStation's multi renderer declaration.
DisplaySyncPolicy uses Thor's 60/120-Hz modes, and Eden forces Docked. Qualification must discover device limits rather than assuming these settings fit every GPU.
